blocks.text: Murrayville homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Murrayville, October 2026. Detached houses: 37 listed at month end and 3 sold in October, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 31 listed at month end and 7 sold in October, a sales ratio of 23% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 20 sold over 5 months against an average of 27.4 listed, about 6.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 5 sold. Condos and townhomes: 33 sold over 5 months against an average of 31.0 listed, about 4.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 8 sold.

faq.q: Is Langley Memorial Hospital in Murrayville?
faq.a: Fraser Health lists Langley Memorial Hospital at 22051 Fraser Highway, Langley, as a community hospital with 24/7 emergency services, open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; the live page places the hospital in Murrayville's hospital and civic area

faq.q: How many units can an eligible Murrayville lot hold under SSMUH?
faq.a: Under Township Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024): 3 units for lots of 280 m² or less and 4 units for lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², if the lot is inside the Urban Containment Boundary, on municipal water and sewer, not heritage-designated and not in a Transit-Oriented Area; lots over 4,050 m² are not eligible and there is no 6-unit tier in the Township

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Murrayville?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 37 houses listed with 3 sold in the month and 31 condos and townhomes listed with 7 sold in the month in Murrayville. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Murrayville a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 8%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 23%, a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
